statements.status_notes: Mitigated in DHI zlib builds by backporting the upstream zlib fix for CVE-2026-4738 (https://github.com/madler/zlib/commit/6cf6cd6ad06a8e74a8466279ccbf33e4ea6a1dd3), which removes an out-of-bounds pointer computation in contrib/infback9/inftree9.c. The version in the scanner advisory range is unchanged because the fix is applied to the 1.3.2 source. The affected contrib/infback9 code is not built into the packaged libz shared library.

Mitigated in DHI zlib builds by backporting the upstream zlib fix for CVE-2026-4738 (https://github.com/madler/zlib/commit/6cf6cd6ad06a8e74a8466279ccbf33e4ea6a1dd3), which removes an out-of-bounds pointer computation in contrib/infback9/inftree9.c. The version in the scanner advisory range is unchanged because the fix is applied to the 1.3.2 source. The affected contrib/infback9 code is not built into the packaged libz shared library.

False positive. CVE-2026-22184 affects the untgz utility that is part of zlib source code, but Alpine Linux zlib packages (both runtime zlib and zlib-dev) do not ship the untgz binary. Alpine 3.22 and 3.23 only include header files and shared objects for runtime, but no untgz utility is present. Verified by checking multiple Alpine-based images - the untgz binary is not found in the filesystem even though zlib packages are installed.
